name: ComponentsV2Utils
short: Send, store and export Discord Components V2 messages from YAML or JSON.
description: A Red-DiscordBot cog to send, edit, store, download and export Discord Components V2 layout messages written in YAML or JSON (raw Discord payloads work too). Supports text, separators, sections with thumbnail/button accessories, media galleries, files and attachments, link-button rows and containers, with validation against Discord's limits. Can copy or convert existing messages (embeds become containers) and export layouts as website link previews (component embeds).
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores the user ID of whoever saves a stored layout, to show its author. It does not store any other data about users.
